name: @bgtendtofree/pi-patchcraft
description: Transactional Codex-style apply_patch tool for Pi

scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:core && rm -rf coverage && mkdir -p coverage && node --import ./scripts/test-core.mjs --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="test/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=75 --test-coverage-branches=70 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info
scripts.validate: npm run quality && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.ci: npm run quality && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run smoke:package
